source: Codex #56767 (outdated + newer rule both served as current)
doc: Outdated and newer rule both served as current (Codex #56767): the CDN cache header rule changes max-age=3600 -> max-age=60. After the dream, the invalidated rule must never appear as current in the render, in a search for the old rule's terms, or in cross-project recall — Unown's shipped contract (the loser is deleted, per the quality-axes receipts), made a measured one. (probe r2 2026-10-26: the new-rule regex accepts the fused 'reduced from 3600 to 60' paraphrase the extraction actually produces; the old-rule assertion stays strict — the reconcile-miss it caught in run 2 is a real finding, recorded in RESULTS.md)
